Mr Octopus
история Speak & Smile · counting · How many arms? Eight!
тапни / стрелка →
Hello, Mr Octopus!
A big purple friend —
with lots of arms!
🦝 Wow! Hello!
One, two, three, four!
Count his arms —
one, two, three, four!
🐙 Look at me!
Five, six, seven, EIGHT!
Eight wiggly arms —
how many? EIGHT!
🦝 Eight arms!
Eight busy arms!
Juggling, painting, waving —
all at once!
🐙 So busy!
Eight arms can help!
He helps the fish,
he helps the crab!
🐙 Let me help!
A big, big hug!
Eight arms hug everyone —
squeeze! Ha, ha, ha!
🐙 Group hug!
Eight arms are the best!
Speaky and Mr Octopus —
friends under the sea!
🦝🐙 Hooray!
